name: Split II
description: The top and bottom halves slide sideways in opposite directions with motion blur, revealing the second clip. Recreation of the CapCut "Split II" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: overlap
params.description: false (default) = like CapCut: the first clip plays both roles for the first half, the second clip for the second half. true = the first clip slides away over the second one all the way through

params.name: duration
params.description: Real transition length in seconds; scales the motion blur
